summary: Welcome amigos... to the day of the dead. Structured changes across 20 entities this patch.

champions.name: Azir
champions.gameplayImpact: Azir loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Cooldown
lines.note: Cooldown increased to 14–6 seconds from 12–6.

champions.name: Briar
champions.tldr: Recommended items and runes have been updated.; Attack speed growth reduced to 2.3% from 2.5%.
champions.gameplayImpact: Briar was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recommended items and runes have been updated.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Transitions from her attack to idle animation now play correctly.

lines.label: Attack speed growth
lines.note: Attack speed growth reduced to 2.3% from 2.5%.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Spell shield now also blocks applications of bleed stacks from blocked spells when the first stack was already applied.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now properly tagged as an attack reset for interactions like Hail of Blades}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Targeting an enemy over terrain now consistently causes her to dash to their location on the other side, rather than landing in front of the wall if the target was not far enough away from the wall on the other side.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Frenzy duration is now also displayed on her resource bar on the health bar, and color-coded.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Tooltip now clarifies that casting it does not remove or replace the empowered Blood Frenzy granted by Certain Death}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Dash no longer cancels existing movement commands.

lines.label: Healing
lines.note: Healing changed to 36–60% from 35–65%.

lines.label: Non-champion damage
lines.note: Non-champion damage reduced to 110% from 120%.

lines.label: Monster health ratio damage cap
lines.note: Monster health ratio damage cap reduced to 400 from 500.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Percent health damage is no longer affected by critical strike modifiers.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now has a brief cooldown after gaining Blood Frenzy}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Now makes displaced enemies collide with player-generated terrain more consistently.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Frenzy duration is now also displayed on her resource bar on the health bar, and color-coded.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Pinging the ability now tells teammates which enemies are within its cast range.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Berserk is now properly canceled if the the target dies during the cast time of the second cast.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: No longer creates the explosion around the target if the dash is interrupted by the summoner spell.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Now behaves properly when interacting with Devour (Tahm Kench)}} and Fate's Call (Kalista)}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: True sight debuff now properly expires if she enters a resurrection state during the berserk effect.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: VFX now properly plays even if cast at maximum range.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Yuumi}} is now properly revealed by the true sight debuff even while she is untargetable from You and Me!}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: No longer fails to enter the berserk state with Blood Frenzy}} upon reaching the target and consequently create two explosions under certain conditions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Chilling Scream}}

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: SFX for the ability now plays correctly.
